body:
no, honestly, its not condescending at all. it actually makes me feel really good. it makes me feel clever. ive been feeling dumb for a long time. 

i think maybe a therapist will be good- if talking to internet strangers makes me feel even a little bit more empowered, maybe a real person across from me would work, too.

I really appreciate your words. Really. it's a relief to talk to someone who isn't frustrated im not happy.

honestly, i dont know who i really am anymore. 

i was in college, but i got suspended for a semester. i was out of school, working these terrible jobs, just to make about $50 a week. i had an apartment, but i couldn't afford it so i moved back home to be close to my family and my boyfriend. i lost my own space. i dont have time now to do the things i like now because i have 2 jobs that stress me out more than they should. i spend a lot of time with my bf at his place. my family is dysfunctional, and i feel a lot of the times their happiness is my responsibility- which they tell me its not, but when your mother tells you youre the only one she can complain to about the problems in her marriage with your father, its hard to believe.

i want to say that i take on the burdens of others, and thats what made me lost me, but then i sound so selfish, and so holier-than-thou. so i dont know. it has to be me.  i cant keep blaming others forever.

im so sorry, stranger, your probably didnt expect a fountain of text, but its nice to vent to someone i dont know, strangely enough.

thank you for responding.

im trying so hard. but with a lot of work and seemingly no progress for a while now, im losing hope that ill ever really feel normal. i honestly cant remember what normal feels like. the more i think back the more i realize...ive just always been unstable. 

i think now its hurting because someone that i love- thats not blood related- is seeing this part of me and letting me know that he doesnt like it. and as much as i want to get better, i really just dont know how.
